title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Damage Protection Schedule by Equipment Class
content:
Ridgeline Tool Rental damage protection is priced and limited by equipment class. The figures below are the class figures of the plan; the plan's charging and coverage rules apply them.

## Schedule

| Equipment class | Charge, percent of rental time charges | Must be taken | May be declined with a commercial certificate of insurance on file | Coverage limit per incident, USD | Deductible per incident, USD |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools | 15 | no | no | 500.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care | 15 | no | no | 1000.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape | 15 | no | no | 1500.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | 15 | no | no | 2500.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting | 12 | yes | yes | 5000.00 | 250.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | 12 | yes | yes | 10000.00 | 500.00 |

## Exclusions and charging base by class

| Equipment class | Loss and theft excluded | Tire and track damage excluded | Charge figured on rental time after the ProBuild discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools | yes | no | yes |
| Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care | yes | no | yes |
| Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape | yes | no | yes |
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | yes | no | yes |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting | yes | yes | yes |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | yes | yes | yes |

## Terms of the schedule

- **Coverage limit per incident**: the largest repair cost per incident that damage protection covers for accidental damage.
- **Deductible per incident**: the amount per incident the renter pays even with damage protection.
- **Must be taken**: a class marked yes requires damage protection, except that in a class marked yes in the certificate column a renter with a commercial certificate of insurance on file may decline it.

## Points of judgement

- *Is damage protection optional on a hand-held tool?* Yes. In the four classes marked "no" under "Must be taken" the renter chooses at checkout.
- *What is the deductible per incident on this schedule for each class?* 250.00 for Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting and 500.00 for Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment; the schedule figure for each of the other four classes is 0.00.
